challenges.name: null-safety-quiz
challenges.title: Predict it: ?., ?: and !!
challenges.description: Work out what a safe call and an elvis operator give when the precedence is not what it looks like, then pick the lines that cannot crash.

questions.question:
A profile has no ward. What does this print?

val ward: String? = null
println("Ward: " + ward?.length ?: 0)
questions.explanation: + binds tighter than ?:, so the line is ("Ward: " + ward?.length) ?: 0. ward?.length is null, and String.plus accepts any value, including null, which it turns into the text "null": the left side is "Ward: null". That string is not null, so the elvis operator keeps it and the 0 is never used (the compiler even warns that the elvis is useless). "Ward: 0" needs parentheses: "Ward: " + (ward?.length ?: 0). There is no exception: ?. never throws, and nothing here uses !!.

questions.question: Given val phone: String? = null, which of these lines compile AND run without throwing an exception? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: phone?.length is a safe call: it gives null and println prints null. Inside if (phone != null) the compiler smart-casts phone to String, so phone.length compiles; the condition is false and nothing runs. "12a".toIntOrNull() returns null instead of throwing, and the elvis turns it into -1. phone.length does not compile at all: only safe (?.) or non-null asserted (!!.) calls are allowed on a nullable receiver. phone!!.length compiles, which is exactly the problem: !! throws a NullPointerException when phone is null. A map lookup with [] returns null for a missing key, so !! after it throws as well; getValue would throw NoSuchElementException instead.

challenges.name: fix-cart-header-crash
challenges.title: Fix the cart header that crashes on incomplete profiles
challenges.description: The Cho Xanh cart screen greets the customer, shows the delivery address and the delivery fee of the district. Release 4.13 builds that header with !! everywhere and crashes for customers who signed up with Zalo (no display name), have no address yet, or have an address without a street or ward. Fix greeting, deliverTo and deliveryFee without !!: fall back to "Hi there", skip missing address parts, ask for an address when there is none, and show "n/a" when no fee is known. The test runner reads one profile per line and prints one header per profile.

tests.name: Complete profiles work before and after the fix
tests.input:
CX-U01|Lan|Hoan Kiem|Hang Bac|12 Hang Bac
CX-U03|Pham Quang Huy|Cau Giay|Dich Vong|88 Tran Thai Tong
tests.expected:
CX-U01: Hi Lan | Deliver to: 12 Hang Bac, Hang Bac, Hoan Kiem | Fee: 15000 VND
CX-U03: Hi Pham Quang Huy | Deliver to: 88 Tran Thai Tong, Dich Vong, Cau Giay | Fee: 20000 VND
